title: Fix topbar notifications bell: remove redundant Settings shortcut or implement a minimal notification panel
goal: The topbar has two buttons that both navigate to Settings: (1) the bell icon (data-testid='topbar-notifications', aria-label='Open notification settings', data-nav-screen='settings'), and (2) the gear icon (data-testid='topbar-settings', aria-label='Settings', data-nav-screen='settings'). Having two buttons that do the same thing is confusing. Choose one of these solutions: OPTION A (preferred): Remove the bell icon entirely. One Settings button (gear) is sufficient. Notifications can be a section within Settings. OPTION B: Keep the bell but give it a purpose — implement a lightweight notification panel (a dropdown or slide-in panel) that shows recent system events (run completions, critical finding alerts, CVE sync results, CI/CD trigger events) drawn from the existing status_feed data. The panel should not require a backend change for the core mechanic. If neither option is feasible in one slice, choose OPTION A.
scope: System review 2026-05-01: Topbar has bell icon and gear icon both navigating to Settings (data-nav-screen='settings'). Bell aria-label says 'Open notification settings' implying a notifications-specific destination but lands on the same Settings screen as the gear. This confuses operators and wastes topbar space.
generation_reason: System review 2026-05-01: Bell and gear both navigate to Settings — either give bell a dedicated purpose or remove it.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Remove the bell OR give it a minimal dedicated panel. Do not build a full notification backend. Do not redesign the topbar.

success_criteria: There is at most one button in the topbar that navigates to Settings.
If a notification panel is implemented, it shows at least recent run status events from state.
If the bell is removed, the topbar has only the gear button for Settings.
The Settings screen remains fully reachable.

acceptance_criteria: No two topbar buttons navigate to the same destination.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the only active task.
after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
